headline: Nine Jailed in Turkey Over HABAŞ Steel-Plant Explosion
deck: Court action over the Aliağa blast leaves its cause unestablished; production at the plant is suspended.
body: A Turkish court jailed nine people pending trial over the explosion at a steel plant in western Turkey while putting the company’s chairman and another suspect under house arrest, Turkish Minute reported. [E1]
The independent Health and Safety Labor Watch said 19 workers had died after Abdullah Kılınç, who had been critically injured in the explosion, died in hospital on Wednesday. [E2]
The cause of the explosion had yet to be established. [E3]
Labor and Social Security Minister Vedat Işıkhan said preliminary findings indicated that falling material ruptured natural-gas and oxygen pipes during maintenance. [E4]
Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said a crane had collapsed during routine work on an electric arc furnace. [E5]
The Menemen Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office opened an investigation and assigned four prosecutors; Turkey Today also reported that production at the plant was suspended. [E6]
